clue.text: Senator must be involved in betrayal

indicators.note: letters that are involved get tangled up together, so the word they belong to is rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A politician caught up in a plot against the state.
explanation.walkthrough: The senator who seems to be the traitor is simply the letters of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is the crime of betraying one's own country or sovereign.

clue.text: Draw northern urban area

parts.note: to tow is to draw or pull along
N is the abbreviation for northern

explanation.surface: Sketching a built-up place in the north of a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' suggests a pencil, but it is meant in its pulling sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A town is a built-up settlement, smaller than a city, so an urban area.

clue.text: Gourmet has cooked pie with kipper

indicators.note: cooked food is transformed from its raw state, so the word next to it is remade in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, as letters to rearrange
to kipper fish is to cure it by salting and smoking

explanation.surface: A food lover dines on a pie served alongside smoked fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kipper' reads as the fish, but here it is the verb for smoking fish, which equals cure.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicure is a person with refined taste in food and drink, a synonym of gourmet.

clue.text: Opposition shown to rep as listener's case unfolds?

indicators.note: as a story unfolds it opens out in new shapes, so the preceding words are laid out differently

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used in the rearrangement

explanation.surface: A courtroom-sounding picture of a hearer's argument developing against a representative.
explanation.walkthrough: A rep is a sales representative; the whole clue reads like a legal case unfolding but the words are the letters of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sales resistance is customers' reluctance to buy, the opposition a travelling salesman meets.

clue.text: Beautiful youth in plant

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the handsome young man of Greek myth who fell in love with his reflection
second meaning: the genus of bulbs that includes daffodils

explanation.surface: A good-looking young man spotted among the greenery.
explanation.walkthrough: The flower was named after the myth: it grew where the youth pined away beside the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend the beautiful youth is called by this name, and it is also the botanical name of the daffodil family.

clue.text: Cook using good sieve

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
a riddle is a coarse sieve for soil or gravel

explanation.surface: A chef straining something through a decent sieve.
explanation.walkthrough: A riddle is a garden or builder's sieve, a sense unrelated to puzzles.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to griddle is to cook on a flat heated iron plate.

clue.text: Former cricket captain about to enter carriage

indicators.note: one thing entering another goes inside it, so the short word ends up within the longer

parts.note: a gig is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A retired cricket skipper climbing into a coach.
explanation.walkthrough: Tony Greig captained England at cricket in the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: Tony Greig was a former England Test cricket captain, so his surname fits.

clue.text: Intermediary who might make a cover charge?

definitions.text: Intermediary who might make a cover charge?

parts.note: surface reading: a cover charge is the extra fee a restaurant or nightclub adds per diner

parts.words: Intermediary who might make a cover charge?
parts.note: setter's reading: a go-between who charges you for insurance cover on a policy

explanation.walkthrough: 'Cover charge' sounds like a restaurant fee, but cover here is insurance protection, and the charge is the premium.
explanation.definitionFit: This agent arranges policies between clients and insurers, charging for the protection obtained.

clue.text: Doctor Lane strangles a copper in this gothic novel

indicators.note: a strangler's hands close around a neck, so these words wrap round the letters that follow

parts.note: DR is the usual abbreviation for doctor
La. is the street-name abbreviation for lane
taken as written
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A murderous physician in a horror story throttles a policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: Doctor and lane together form the outer wrapping, with A and copper held between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Bram Stoker's vampire tale of 1897 is the classic gothic horror novel.

clue.text: Can our idea upset one from Quito, maybe?

indicators.note: something upset is knocked over and disordered, so the preceding words are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a plan of ours could offend a South American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' warns that a Quito resident is just one example of the wider nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: Quito is the capital of Ecuador, so someone from there is an example of a national of that country.

clue.text: Legal document's comprehensive — that's very obvious

parts.note: a writ is a formal written court order
large in the sense of broad or wide-ranging

explanation.surface: A lawyer remarks that a lengthy contract makes things plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Something writ large is shown in an exaggerated, unmistakable form, so it is plain to see.

clue.text: Chaos caused by United supporters on the way back

indicators.note: travelling back retraces the route in the opposite direction, so the letters run from right to left

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for United, as in football club names
fans are a team's supporters

explanation.surface: Football fans making trouble as they travel home from a United match.
explanation.walkthrough: The scene of rowdy fans on the journey home hides that the whole of United plus supporters is read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Snafu is originally military slang for a muddled, chaotic situation.

clue.text: Does so much better than groups in the neighbourhood on courses

indicators.note: placed on means coming after in an across answer, so the pieces before this word follow the one after it

parts.note: runs are courses, as in ski runs, and to course is to run
rings are groups or cartels, as in a spy ring
round as in 'live round here', nearby

explanation.surface: Comparing a local team's performance on the racecourses with rival syndicates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' places the first two pieces after the last-named one, so courses comes at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: To run rings round someone is an idiom for outperforming them easily.

clue.text: Plant, iris, adapts to change

indicators.note: a thing made to change takes on a different form, so the preceding words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: A garden iris adjusting to new conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: The iris looks like the plant being defined, but it is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The aspidistra is a hardy leafy houseplant, famously a Victorian parlour favourite.

clue.text: Part of play watched in audition?

indicators.note: an audition is a hearing, so the word is judged by how it sounds rather than its spelling

parts.note: seen means watched, and is pronounced the same as the theatre term

explanation.surface: An actor's piece observed at a tryout for a stage role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Audition' fits the theatre picture but is used in its root sense of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A play is divided into acts and these smaller sections set in one place.

clue.text: Newcomer with artist settling in for good in Scottish town

indicators.note: settling in for someone means taking their place, so one piece is swapped for another

parts.note: a stranger is someone new to a place
RA is a Royal Academician, the usual crossword artist
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: An incomer and a painter make their home in a Scottish place for good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For good' reads as permanently, but good is the letter replaced. Stranraer is a port town in south-west Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Stranraer is a ferry port town in Dumfries and Galloway, south-west Scotland.

clue.text: Stagger factory with thrift, say

parts.note: to rock is to stagger or sway
a plant is an industrial works

explanation.surface: Amazing an industrial works by its economising.
explanation.walkthrough: Thrift looks like a virtue but is the sea pink, a flower; 'say' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrift, or sea pink, grows on cliffs and is a classic example of a flower for rockeries.

clue.text: Genuine native?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: real, belonging to a thing's true nature, as in real worth
second meaning: inborn, inherent rather than acquired

explanation.walkthrough: 'Native' reads as a person from a place; here it is the adjective for something inborn.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes what is essential and inherent to something, so both its real and its inborn qualities.

clue.text: Girl supplying article about South America

parts.note: the definite article
re means about or concerning
SA is the abbreviation for South America

explanation.surface: A young woman providing a magazine piece on Latin America.
explanation.definitionFit: Theresa is a female first name, so it can stand for a girl in crossword convention.

clue.text: Girl in Israeli port, returning around one

indicators.note: returning means going back the way you came, so the result is read backwards
around means surrounding, so the port's letters enclose the single letter

parts.note: Acre is a port in northern Israel
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A young woman coming back to an Israeli harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is a female first name, so it can stand for a girl in crossword convention.

clue.text: Trendy girl in a state

parts.note: in means fashionable
Diana is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A fashionable young woman who is all worked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a state' reads as an idiom for agitated, but 'a state' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Indiana is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: Pitied any red at dodgy line-up

indicators.note: something dodgy is unreliable and not straight, so the preceding letters are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written, every letter used

explanation.surface: Sympathy for a communist caught up in a suspect police lineup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dodgy' fits the police picture of suspects, but it is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A police line-up of suspects for a witness to pick from is the British identity parade.

clue.text: Row across British river

indicators.note: lying across something means spanning it, so the first word stretches around the next

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
B is the abbreviation for British

explanation.surface: An argument breaking out across a British waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' tempts as a quarrel or rowing a boat, but it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tiber is the river that flows through Rome.

clue.text: Like a king at home

parts.note: taken as written; that the clue's 'a king' also happens to contain the letters running on is a coincidence
K is the chess abbreviation for king
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: Behaving like a monarch relaxing in his own palace.
explanation.definitionFit: Akin means similar or related, so it can replace like as an adjective.

clue.text: Wooden old actor given lead in Notorious

parts.note: Sir Herbert Beerbohm Tree was a Victorian actor-manager

indicators.note: the lead of a word is what goes in front, so only its opening letter is used

parts.note: the opening letter of this word

explanation.surface: A stiff veteran performer cast as the star of a Hitchcock film.
explanation.walkthrough: Notorious is a Hitchcock film, so the surface suggests casting; Beerbohm Tree is a standard crossword old actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Treen is an old word meaning made of wood, and names small wooden household objects.

clue.text: Card game in bar attracting sailor

parts.note: to black something is to boycott or ban it, as a trade union might
a jack, or Jack tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor drawn to a gambling game in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' reads as a pub, but it is the verb to ban, which black also means. 'Attracting' just places the sailor after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackjack, also called twenty-one or pontoon, is a casino card game.

clue.text: Unskilled, a graduate? True, curiously

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: curiously means in an odd way, so the word before it is arranged oddly

parts.note: an MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate
taken as written, as letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone questions whether a graduate can really be untrained.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateur used as an adjective means unprofessional or lacking expert skill.

clue.text: Turtle avoiding soft ground

indicators.note: avoiding something means keeping it out, so that letter is dropped

parts.note: a terrapin is a small freshwater turtle
p, piano, is the musical direction for soft

explanation.surface: A turtle keeping off muddy, yielding land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soft ground' reads as one phrase, but soft belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain means land considered by its physical features, a stretch of ground.
